name: Luminous Peptide Glaze Serum
description: An ultra-concentrated Parisian botanical elixir infusing multi-peptides, pure French botanical seed oils, and 3% niacinamide to illuminate skin while reinforcing cellular lipid barriers.

formulation.skinType: All skin types, optimized for delicate & sensitive skin

accordions.bioActives: 5% Multi-Peptide Complex stimulates collagen renewal and epidermal elasticity. 3% Niacinamide smooths hyperpigmentation and refines pore architecture. French Camellia Seed Oil provides concentrated Omega-3, 6, and 9 essential fatty acids.
accordions.inci: Aqua (Water), Camellia Oleifera Seed Oil, Niacinamide, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7, Sodium Hyaluronate, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Carbomer, Polysorbate 20, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Tocopherol (Vitamin E).
accordions.ritual: Dispense 3–4 drops onto freshly cleansed, damp skin. Gently press into face, neck, and décolletage using upward lymphatic sweeping motions. Follow with Botanical Hydration Crème. Use morning and evening.
accordions.nafdac: NAFDAC Reg. No. 04-9218. Verified and manufactured in adherence to strict cGMP cosmetic guidelines for efficacy and safety.

name: Parisian Mineral Sun Shield SPF 50
description: A weightless fluid SPF 50 engineered specifically to leave zero white cast or ashiness, formulated in France with antioxidant-dense botanical seed oils and mineral photoprotectors.

accordions.bioActives: Pure French botanical seed oil shields against cellular photo-damage while providing lightweight, non-greasy lipid protection. Ectoin shields skin from infrared radiation and atmospheric pollution.
accordions.inci: Aqua, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Oil, Prunus Domestica Seed Oil, Zinc Oxide, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Ectoin, Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate, Squalane, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glyceryl Stearate, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Caprylyl Glycol, Silica.
accordions.ritual: Apply liberally as the final step of your morning skincare ritual, 15 minutes prior to sun exposure. Reapply every 2 hours or following swimming, sweating, or towel drying.
accordions.nafdac: NAFDAC Reg. No. 04-8842. Broad spectrum UVA/UVB protection tested to ISO 24444 standards.

name: Botanical Purifying Jelly Cleanser
description: A gentle low-foaming jelly cleanser formulated in France that removes waterproof cosmetics, environmental particulates, and excess sebum without stripping the skin's delicate moisture mantle.

accordions.bioActives: Hydrolyzed French plant proteins form a protective moisture veil during cleansing. Chamomile flower hydrosol and rose water soothe cutaneous reactivity and calm inflammation.
accordions.inci: Aqua, Glycerin, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein, Chamomilla Recutita Flower Water, Rosa Damascena Flower Water, Panthenol, Xanthan Gum, Citric Acid, Benzyl Alcohol, Dehydroacetic Acid.
accordions.ritual: Massage 1–2 pumps onto damp skin in circular motions for 60 seconds. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water. Pat dry with an organic cotton cloth.
accordions.nafdac: NAFDAC Reg. No. 04-7193. Hypoallergenic and ophthalmologist tested for eye safety.

name: Botanical Hydration Crème
tagline: Ceramide Infused French Botanical Lipid Replenishment
description: A sumptuous, cushiony moisturiser formulated in Paris featuring French plant-derived squalane, multi-ceramides, and fermented yeast filtrates to lock in 72-hour moisture.

accordions.bioActives: Ceramide Complex NP, AP, and EOP mirrors the natural lipid composition of the human stratum corneum. Plant squalane delivers high concentrations of pure emollients for velvety barrier cushioning.
accordions.inci: Aqua, Squalane, Butyrospermum Parkii Butter, Ceramide NP, Ceramide AP, Ceramide EOP, Phytosphingosine, Cholesterol, Galactomyces Ferment Filtrate, Centella Asiatica Leaf Extract, Sodium Lauroyl Lactylate, Carbomer, Phenoxyethanol.
accordions.ritual: Warm a hazelnut-sized portion between fingertips and press into face, neck, and collarbones following serum application. Ideal for both AM and PM rituals.
accordions.nafdac: NAFDAC Reg. No. 04-9405. Formulated without pore-clogging waxes or synthetic dyes.

name: Parisian Botanical Barrier Oil
tagline: Virgin Cold-Pressed Botanical Concentrate Imported from France
description: 100% pure cold-pressed French botanical squalane and rosehip seed oil, rich in polyphenols, flavonoids, and natural lipids to repair damaged barriers and restore incandescent luminosity.

accordions.bioActives: High levels of essential fatty acids and potent antioxidants combat cellular oxidation, calm skin reactivity, and lock in trans-epidermal moisture.
accordions.inci: Rosa Rubiginosa (Rosehip) Seed Oil, Squalane, Tocopherol (Vitamin E). Zero additives, preservatives, or artificial fragrances.
accordions.ritual: Press 2–3 drops onto clean skin as the final sealing step in your evening ritual, or mix 1 drop into your foundation or moisturiser for a bespoke dewy finish.
accordions.nafdac: NAFDAC Reg. No. 04-8119. Certified 100% pure organic botanical origin.

name: Hibiscus AHA Glow Tonic
tagline: Gentle Micro-Exfoliating Flower Acid Resurfacing Elixir
description: A Parisian exfoliating botanical tonic marrying hibiscus flower acids with gentle lactic acid and soothing botanical waters to dissolve cellular debris without irritation.

formulation.skinType: Skin prone to texture, uneven tone, and congestion

accordions.bioActives: Organic hibiscus flower acids stimulate rapid cell turnover while natural flower extracts soothe cutaneous irritation. Licorice Root Extract balances uneven tone.
accordions.inci: Aqua, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Lactic Acid, Hibiscus Sabdariffa Flower Extract, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract, Sodium Hydroxide, Glycerin, Propanediol, Allantoin, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin.
accordions.ritual: Saturate a reusable cotton pad and sweep across cleansed face and neck, avoiding the eye contour. Use 2–3 evenings per week. Always follow with SPF 50 during the day.
accordions.nafdac: NAFDAC Reg. No. 04-7801. Formulated to safely resurface without photosensitizing delicate skin.
